title: The Role of Buried Streams in Flood Management
text: Cities often bury streams in culverts beneath streets. During heavy rain, paved surfaces can quickly send water into drains, often overwhelming them before the water can be carried away. Restoring an open stream can be beneficial because it creates space to hold floodwater and offers habitat for wildlife. However, restoring these streams is not simple. It requires substantial room, funding, and very careful planning. It is crucial to understand that restoring a stream does not eliminate every single source of flood risk.
